title: The Quantum Kid
author: emoskv
description: Can a 9-year-old help decode the future of quantum tech? In this unique podcast, Kai — aka The Quantum Kid — teams up with his mom to ask bold questions that challenge a quantum expert and a business leader in every episode. Each 20-minute show makes cutting-edge ideas fun, clear, and surprisingly useful. Smart, curious minds of any age welcome.

episodes_recents.titre: 3 Big Wows! Quantum Computing, New Drugs, and a 3D-Printed Human Ear!
Can Quantum Computing Make Robots Smarter?
Can quantum computing reinvent manufacturing? (With a little help from a 3D printed panda)
Step with Kai into the ETH Zurich Quantum Lab - and program a quantum computer!
Can Quantum Computers Help US Explore Space?
